title: Omaclipsync
conflict: Local and remote copies conflict; use Push to choose the local clipboard
expired: Pending copy expired; use Push to confirm the current clipboard
re_pair: Server was restored or this device was revoked; pair again
repair_warning: Pairing again discards unsent local sync data and registers a new device.
storage_error: Encrypted sync state is unavailable; synchronization is paused
credentials: Check credentials or unlock the keyring
notify_note: On by default. Notifications never include clipboard text.
allow_sensitive_note: Off by default. Allows pushing and receiving content marked sensitive by its source app.
sensitive_blocked: Push blocked: the clipboard is marked sensitive.
show_icon_note: When hidden, open the panel with the open or openHistory command.
icon_setting_failed: Could not save the bar icon setting.
password_hint: Leave blank to keep the saved password
history_note: Off by default. You can use system clipboard history instead.
insecure_note: Only enable for a server you trust.
error_config: Could not save settings. Check the values and regular expressions.
error_keyring: Could not save the password. Unlock your keyring and try again.
error_sync: Sync failed. Check the connection and credentials.
error_history: Could not read or update history.
error_generic: The sync service could not complete the request.
setup_hint: The password is stored in your system keyring.
dedupe_full: Deduplication memory is full; newly received content will wait for older entries to expire.
favorite_limit: You can save up to 5 favorites. Remove one first.
favorite_note: Up to 5 favorites; clearing history keeps them.
paste_unavailable: Copied. Paste was cancelled because the original window is unavailable.
auto_apply_sensitive_note: When off, keep only the latest item in the encrypted inbox. When on, write new items directly to the system clipboard.
inbox_auto_note: Automatic clipboard writing is on. New sensitive items go directly to the system clipboard.
inbox_truncated: Preview truncated. Copy still copies the complete original text.
inbox_stale: This item has changed or was deleted. Try again.
inbox_failed: Operation failed. Check the background service and try again.
